description: This Java source file defines the MetadataModelFactory class, a utility factory responsible for creating and initializing Metadata objects, including empty, null, or from JSON data. It also provides builder creation methods for Metadata objects.

classes.name: MetadataModelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Metadata instances with methods for generating empty, null, or initialized Metadata objects from JSON data.

methods.name: emptyMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable empty Metadata object.

methods.name: nullMetadata
methods.description: Returns a new immutable Metadata object representing null.

methods.name: newMetadata (JsonObject jsonObject)
methods.description: Creates a new Metadata object initialized with values from the provided JsonObject, validating keys with a pattern.

methods.name: newMetadata (String jsonString)
methods.description: Creates a new Metadata object from a JSON string, parsing it into a JsonObject.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder for constructing Metadata objects.

methods.name: newMetadataBuilder(final Metadata metadata)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder initialized with an existing Metadata object.
